tablets.whyUsed: Almost non-drowsy antihistamine good for long-term allergies
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Loratadine/cetirizine preferred; avoid 1st gen
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid alcohol - increases drowsiness

tablets.name: Montelukast
tablets.dosage: 10mg once daily at bedtime (5mg for children)
tablets.whyUsed: Calms airway inflammation to prevent breathing problems
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid decongestants 1st trimester; consult doctor
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - increases drowsiness and liver strain

tablets.name: Salbutamol
tablets.dosage: Inhaler: 1-2 puffs as needed (up to 4 hourly); tablet form rare
tablets.whyUsed: Opens the airways within minutes during breathing trouble
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid decongestants 1st trimester; consult doctor
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - increases drowsiness and liver strain

tablets.name: Budesonide
tablets.dosage: Inhaler: 200-800mcg daily in divided doses as prescribed
tablets.whyUsed: Daily preventive inhaler that stops asthma attacks before they start
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid decongestants 1st trimester; consult doctor
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - increases drowsiness and liver strain

tablets.name: Pseudoephedrine
tablets.dosage: 30-60mg every 4-6 hours (avoid at night)
tablets.whyUsed: Clears a stuffed nose so you can breathe and sleep
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid decongestants 1st trimester; consult doctor
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - increases drowsiness and liver strain

tablets.name: Ambroxol
tablets.dosage: 30mg three times a day or 75mg sustained-release twice daily
tablets.whyUsed: Thins and loosens mucus so coughing clears the chest easily
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid decongestants 1st trimester; consult doctor
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - increases drowsiness and liver strain

tablets.name: Fluoxetine
tablets.dosage: 20-60mg once daily in the morning
tablets.whyUsed: Lifts mood over weeks by restoring the brain's serotonin balance
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Sertraline
tablets.dosage: 50mg once daily (25mg start, adjusted by doctor)
tablets.whyUsed: Gentle daily tablet widely used for depression and anxiety
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Escitalopram
tablets.dosage: 10-20mg once daily
tablets.whyUsed: Less queasy than other antidepressants with a proven calming effect
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Amitriptyline
tablets.dosage: 10-25mg at bedtime (slowly increased by doctor)
tablets.whyUsed: An evening dose that eases nerve pain and helps you sleep
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Gabapentin
tablets.dosage: 300mg starting, increased gradually 3 times a day (as directed)
tablets.whyUsed: Specifically targets nerve-type burning and tingling pain
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Pregabalin
tablets.dosage: 75mg twice daily (start low, increase slowly, tapered on stopping)
tablets.whyUsed: Powerful medicine for burning nerve pain and severe anxiety
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Clonazepam
tablets.dosage: 0.25-0.5mg once or twice daily (short-term, habit-forming)
tablets.whyUsed: Rapid relief for sudden panic or seizures, used only short-term
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Alprazolam
tablets.dosage: 0.25-0.5mg when needed (short-term only, habit-forming)
tablets.whyUsed: Fast-acting calm for intense panic and worry episodes
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Carbamazepine
tablets.dosage: 200mg twice daily adjusted by doctor; blood tests sometimes needed
tablets.whyUsed: Controls seizures and sharp facial nerve pain
tablets.maxDailyDose: As prescribed - do not adjust without doctor
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Risk/benefit discussion with psychiatrist essential
tablets.alcoholWarning: Avoid - worsens depression and increases side effects

tablets.name: Mupirocin
tablets.dosage: Apply thin layer to affected area 2-3 times a day for 7 days
tablets.whyUsed: Antibiotic cream that clears skin infections fast
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid retinoids, high-potency steroids; consult dermatologist
tablets.alcoholWarning: Topical: minimal; oral isotretinoin - avoid alcohol

tablets.name: Clotrimazole
tablets.dosage: Cream: apply twice daily for 2-4 weeks; vaginal: 1 insertion at night
tablets.whyUsed: Simple antifungal that clears ringworm and athlete's foot
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid retinoids, high-potency steroids; consult dermatologist
tablets.alcoholWarning: Topical: minimal; oral isotretinoin - avoid alcohol

tablets.name: Betamethasone
tablets.dosage: Thin layer on rash only, once or twice daily (short-term, not on face)
tablets.whyUsed: Strong steroid cream that quickly calms itchy skin rashes
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Avoid retinoids, high-potency steroids; consult dermatologist
tablets.alcoholWarning: Topical: minimal; oral isotretinoin - avoid alcohol

tablets.name: Levothyroxine
tablets.dosage: 25-150mcg once daily in the morning on an empty stomach
sideEffects: On overdose: palpitations, sweating, weight loss
tablets.whyUsed: Daily lifelong replacement that restores normal thyroid function
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Contraindicated - stop if pregnancy suspected
tablets.alcoholWarning: Moderate intake generally okay; liver metabolism affected

tablets.name: Allopurinol
tablets.dosage: 100-300mg once daily after food, taken for life
tablets.whyUsed: Prevents repeat gout attacks by lowering uric acid
tablets.pregnancyWarning: Bisphosphonates contraindicated; calcium/Vit D safe
tablets.alcoholWarning: Limit - alcohol worsens bone loss
